maddeler.e:
أنعتل (form VII)
# أَنْعَتِلُ (ʔanʕatilu) /ʔan.ʕa.ti.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# أَنْعَتِلَ (ʔanʕatila) /ʔan.ʕa.ti.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# أَنْعَتِلْ (ʔanʕatil) /ʔan.ʕa.til/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
